text:
ben: Heads-up — I'm primary for the evening shift but need to swap the 00:00-04:00 UTC chunk. travel delay. can anyone pick up 00:00-02:00 or cover shadow for 00:00-04:00? :wave:
carla: I can take 00:00-02:00 if needed. traveling but should be online then. will need handoff notes. :+1:
alice: I can shadow 00:00-04:00 but can't be primary for escalations (kids' bedtime). I can run initial triage and escalate to on-call backup after 02:30.
devops-bot: Reminder: SRV-rlms scheduled deploy 23:30 UTC — expected low risk, healthcheck pings enabled. If deploy causes alerts, follow runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-failures and notify #incidents. (reacted with :eyes:)
ben: great — carla if you take 00:00-02:00 pls confirm and i'll update rotation and PD. alice, if you shadow can you make sure KV-cache warmup step is in the handoff? last incident we missed that and latency spiked.
carla: confirmed 00:00-02:00. i'll take responsibility for any P1 during that window. pls post exact handoff checklist and PD update, ty.
ben: copying handoff checklist here: 1) confirm PD routing: primary=carla, secondary=ben (for 00:00-02:00) 2) confirm access to prod consoles and rotas 3) prefix cache warmup script in the runbook 4) link to active alerts dashboard 5) contact SRE lead if sustained errors >5m
ben: PD command i'll run once carla confirms: ```/pd assign primary carla``` if you prefer manual, i'll ping ops.
carla: go ahead and run it once you paste the pd command here. also, what about the 02:00-03:00 coverage gap mentioned in the schedule? looks like no one was assigned there.
alice: i can extend shadow to 03:00 if that helps — so we have: carla primary 00:00-02:00, ben primary 02:00-04:00, alice shadow 00:00-03:00. that means ben will take escalations after 02:00.
ben: that works for me. i'll take primary 02:00-04:00. will also set escalation contact to david (SRE pager) if i'm unreachable.
incident-bot: INCIDENT #434: 22:52 UTC — elevated 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate, currently 7% error rate, impact: degraded responses for hosted tier customers. Pager triggered to primary on duty.
ben: noted. i'm triaging now — early signs point at a worker OOM pattern during long generations. pulling logs. 
carla: if incident escalates while i'm primary, what's the agreed handoff? do we follow full P1 runbook or attempt mitigation first?
alice: standard: try quick mitigations (scale up pool, tail logs, restart problematic worker) for <10m. if still failing, declare P1 and follow runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/p1-networking and alert customer-impact channel.
ben: quick actions i ran: bumped worker pool +2, cleared prefix caches for a subset, restarted model-serving process on node-3. error rate dropped to ~3.2% but still higher than baseline. i'm keeping watch.
carla: thanks. if you still see >4% at 23:10 i'll take follow-up while you're swapping. also, log the mitigation steps in the incident thread with timestamps.
ben: will do. running `kubectl logs -n prod model-srv-3 | tail -n 200` now.
ben: (after 10m) error rate back to 1.1%. looks like restart helped. i'm comfortable proceeding with scheduled handover.
carla: ok i'm ready to be primary at 00:00. ben, please run PD assign and paste confirmation. also add runbook pointer to handoff notes: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoffs
ben: ran: ```/pd assign primary carla --note "swap 00:00-02:00 due to travel"``` PD confirms assignment id=PD-78921.
carla: got it — i'm primary. joining the channel at 23:58 for formal handoff. alice, i'll DM you the short checklist for shadowing.
alice: received DM, will be on standby. quick reminder: for cust-impact we use the severity matrix from the ops playbook — customer-notify at sustained >10% errors or SLI breaches.
ben: leaving detailed post-handoff notes: - incident 434 mitigated via restart on model-srv-3 - current error rate 0.8% - watchlist: node-3 + prefix-cache stale keys - deploy at 23:30 completed without regression - contacts: david (SRE), tina (prod-eng) - runbooks: deploy-failures, p1-networking, oncall-handoffs
carla: cheers. taking over. if anything spikes, ping me @carla or call the escalation phone. night all. :wave:
